UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student profile, active language, daily 25-minute goal settings, virtual coins, lives, streak, and serialized local state sync.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

activeLanguageId.description: ISO code of the currently active target language (en, fr, de, it, ru, zh, ja, ko, pt, ht).

activeLevel.description: Current CEFR level in the active language (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1).

learningGoal.description: Student motivation (travel, work, study, conversation, personal).

stateJson.description: Synchronized state snapshot for multi-language progress, SRS queue, and custom 25-min distribution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LanguageProgress.title: LanguageProgress
LanguageProgress.description: Independent learning path progress, CEFR level, and 4-skill competency scores for a specific language.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

languageId.description: Language code (en, fr, de, it, ru, zh, ja, ko, pt, ht).

currentLevel.description: Current CEFR level (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1).

completedLessonsCount.description: Number of lessons completed in this language.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VocabularyCard.title: VocabularyCard
VocabularyCard.description: Spaced repetition (SRS) vocabulary item and mistake tracker.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

intervalDays.description: Current SRS review interval in days.

mistakeCount.description: Number of times missed in exercises or conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user root document storing Cotorra student profile and synchronized study state.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Per-language CEFR progress and 4-skill competency breakdown under the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/vocabulary/{vocabId}.description: Spaced repetition vocabulary cards and recurrent error records under the authenticated user.
